form: DD Form 1351-2, Travel Voucher or Subvoucher (PCS travel claim)
pays_or_does: Settles the PCS travel entitlements (mileage, per diem, TLE, DLA and the rest) and closes out any advances; split disbursement pays the GTCC first.
who_files: The Sailor prepares and signs it; the gaining command's CPPA reviews it and submits it.
deadline: Within 5 working days of reporting, and before house-hunting PTDY. One complete claim, no partials.
filed_where: CPPA via eCRM to TPC Memphis (Navy Travel Processing Center); MyPCS Travel Voucher per NAVADMIN 286/21
attachments: PCS orders with every modification
Receipts for lodging at any amount and for any single expense over $75; zero balance, itemized
NPPSC 7000/1 Travel EFT Information if pay goes to a different account
NPPSC 1300/2 PCS Traveler Checklist (a guide, not a key supporting document)
Dependents claimed must be verified in NSIPS
note: Source note: the Travel Processing Center's routing guidance words the deadline “within 5 days of completing PCS travel”.

unconfirmed.text: Whether the MyPCS Travel Voucher is still the required way to file.
